data.title: Cryo-EM Structure of the Human FLCN-FNIP2-Rag-Ragulator Complex
data.authors: Shen K; Rogala KB; Chou HT; Huang RK; Yu Z; Sabatini DM

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Cryo-EM structure of the human FLCN-FNIP2-Rag-Ragulator complex.
data.abstract_excerpt: mTORC1 controls anabolic and catabolic processes in response to nutrients through the Rag GTPase heterodimer, which is regulated by multiple upstream protein complexes. One such regulator, FLCN-FNIP2, is a GTPase activating protein (GAP) for RagC/D, but despite its important role, how it activates the Rag GTPase heterodimer remains unknown. We used cryo-EM to determine the structure of FLCN-FNIP2 in a complex with the Rag GTPases and Ragulator. FLCN-FNIP2 adopts an extended conformation with two pairs of heterodimerized domains.

extracted_findings.effect: Cryo-EM structure reveals how FLCN-FNIP2 engages the Rag GTPase heterodimer and Ragulator
